name: Déjà Vu
description: Inhabits memory-adjacent neural interfaces and creates the vivid sensation that the current moment has happened before — complete with false memory of how it ended.
observed_behavior: Injects fabricated memory data timed to match current sensory input. The user 'remembers' what happens next. Sometimes the memory is accurate.
story_hooks: A freelancer's déjà vu predicts an ambush accurately — are they precognitive or is the E.L.F. running predictive models?
